how_this_differs_from_the_patrol_runs: The search runs differ from the patrol runs at results/self_improve/memory_factor_v1/ in TWO ways at once - no priors and search-driven looking - so no one may compare the two sets naively. The day-0 whole-house walkthrough is OFF here, so the settled fortnight is learned from scratch rather than given; and every observation comes from a search the robot made to answer a question, at up to 24 room-visits a day against the patrol's 1.26.
